about: Full-strength graha drishti. Every planet aspects the 7th from itself; Mars adds the 4th and 8th, Jupiter the 5th and 9th, Saturn the 3rd and 10th. The engine lists all full aspects as geometry; this file holds the ones that carry a specific classical judgement.

rules.says: Saturn aspects the Moon: the mind carries weight that is not always its own. Realism, caution, and long stretches where nothing feels light.
Saturn aspects the Sun: recognition is withheld until it has been earned twice over, and the relationship with authority, including the father, is formal.
Saturn aspects Venus: affection is dutiful rather than demonstrative, and pleasure is rationed, sometimes by circumstance and sometimes by choice.
Saturn aspects the Lagna: a serious bearing from early on, and a constitution that strengthens with age rather than declining.
Saturn aspects the seventh: marriage arrives late or soberly, and the partnership is held together by obligation as much as by warmth.
Saturn aspects the tenth: the career advances slowly and does not slip back; responsibility arrives before the title does.
Jupiter aspects the Moon: the mind is protected. Good faith survives bad experience, and perspective returns faster than it should.
Jupiter aspects the Lagna: general protection on the body and the reputation; difficulties land, but not as hard as the rest of the chart suggests.
Jupiter aspects the second: money recovers after it is lost, and speech is trusted.
Jupiter aspects the fifth: matters of children and of learning are protected, and judgement improves under pressure.
Jupiter aspects the seventh: the partnership has ballast. Disagreements are survivable and the spouse is a steadying influence.
Jupiter aspects the ninth: fortune is structural rather than lucky, and a teacher turns up at the point of need.
Mars aspects the Moon: feeling arrives fast and hot, with courage that does not need to be summoned and a temper that does not need provoking.
Mars aspects Venus: desire is urgent and direct; attraction is acted on rather than considered.
Mars aspects the seventh: friction in close dealings, whether in marriage or in business. Agreements hold better when they are written down.
Mars aspects the tenth: energetic in the work and willing to take on what others avoid; promotion follows visible effort.
Rahu aspects the Moon: imagination is enlarged past its evidence. Vivid instincts, some of them worth acting on and some of them not.
rules.note: Whether the nodes aspect at all is disputed; many authorities give them only the 7th, others add the 5th and 9th. AstroBot uses the 7th only.

rules.says: The Sun and Moon face each other across the chart: purpose and feeling are in open dialogue, which gives self-knowledge and a certain restlessness. Born near a full moon.
